extracted.name: Turkish Red Lentil Soup with Mint
extracted.description: This hearty red lentil soup recipe is made with red lentils and nutty bulgur in a tomato-based broth with garlic, dried mint, and paprika.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until beginning to soften, about 2 minutes. Stir in garlic and cook for 2 minutes. Add diced tomatoes and cook for 10 minutes.

Stir in chicken stock, lentils, bulgur, rice, tomato paste, mint, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until lentils and rice are tender, about 30 minutes.
Puree soup with an immersion blender until smooth.
